reading.reading: WELCOME WELCOME,  PILGRIM,  TO  THE  GREAT  JOURNEY  TOWARD  THE  END  OF  ALL  THINGS IT  IS  NOT  AN  EASY  TRIP,  BUT  FOR  THOSE  WHO  FIND  THEIR  WAY  HERE  IT  IS  A  NECESSARY  ONE ALONG  THE  WAY  YOU  WILL  FIND  AN  END  TO  ALL  STRUGGLE  AND  SUFFERING,  YOUR  INNOCENCE,  YOUR  ILLUSIONS,  YOUR  CERTAINTY,  AND  YOUR  REALITY ULTIMATELY,  YOU  WILL  DISCOVER  AN  END  TO  SELF IT  IS  THROUGH  THIS  PILGRIMAGE  THAT  WE  SHAPE  OURSELVES  AND  OUR  REALITIES JOURNEY  DEEP  WITHIN  AND  YOU  WILL  ARRIVE  OUTSIDE LIKE  THE  INSTAR,  IT  IS  ONLY  THROUGH  GOING  WITHIN  THAT  WE  MAY  EMERGE WIDSOM YOU  ARE  A  BEING  UNTO  YOURSELF YOU  ARE  A  LAW  UNTO  YOURSELF EACH  INTELLIGENCE  IS  HOLY FOR  ALL  THAT  LIVES  IS  HOLY AN  INSTRUCTION  COMMAND  YOUR  OWN  SELF

notes.title: Leafy border around the Welcome text
notes.text: Thick curving branches surround the central text column. Dense leaf-shaped forms occupy the top, while larger open loops and scattered leaves descend along both margins and curve beneath the text. LP1-03 and LP1-04 share this broad arrangement. It is distinct from the narrow single-margin branching drawings on LP2-08 through LP2-14; no plant species or cipher operation is established by the resemblance.

notes.title: Small red instruction beneath the main text
notes.text: A single line of much smaller red runes sits beneath the main text, just above the lower border. The known reading gives AN INSTRUCTIAN. COMMAND YOUR OWN SELF. Its small size makes it easy to miss in a page thumbnail. It is visible page text, separate from any hidden content extracted from an image.
